sources.title: Outrageously Large Neural Networks: The Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts Layer

sources.details: Using the section GiB definition 1GiB=1024^3=1073741824 bytes: 2127532032*4=8510128128 and /1073741824=7.9256744384765625, rounds7.93; *2=4255064064 and /1073741824=3.9628372192382812, rounds3.96. This stores the same number of weight entries. Qwen vision406957056+language1720574976=2127532032, excluding a second copy of tied output embeddings. Rank8 language q projection 2048->16*128=2048 contributes8*(2048+2048); v projection2048->8*128=1024 contributes8*(2048+1024); 28 layers give28*(32768+24576)=1605632. Total2127532032+241734912+1605632=2370872576=23.70872576*10^8, rounds23.7亿. Small exercise328128*4=1312512 and *2=656256; two-decimal GiB rounds0.0 although byte totals stay nonzero.
